**CONTEXT NOTE: KNEE-SAFE MARATHON TRAINING JOURNEY (WEEKS 1–4) – FINALIZED PLAN SUMMARY**  

**Decisions Made & What Was Chosen Over What:**  
- **Primary training modality**: Low-impact, non-weight-bearing activities (swim, bike, walk) chosen over running as the foundation.  
- **Run days**: Limited to 1x per week, flat terrain, 5-minute walk-in and 5-minute walk-out, with no more than 10 minutes of total time.  
- **Swim progression**: 150m → 200m → 250m → 300m, increasing by no more than 10% per week.  
- **Bike HIIT**: 1x per week, max 10 minutes, total max 3 sessions.  
- **Post-swim ritual**: 2 minutes of isometric glute squeeze (3x, 30-second holds) performed before and after every swim session.  
- **Run volume**: Kept under 10 minutes total per week; no hills, no sprints, no downhill work.  
- **Knee safety protocol**: Immediate stop if pain >4/10 or stiffness >5 minutes; no pushing through discomfort.  

**Open Threads & Next Steps:**  
- Continue weekly swim progression (target: 300m by Week 4).  
- Test 10-minute walk (5-min walk-in, 5-min walk-out) in Week 2, only if no knee feedback.  
- Maintain pre-swim checklist: 5-min warm-up, 2-min glute squeeze, swim log (length, knee rating, stiffness).  
- Add post-run 30-second glute squeeze as a quiet promise to the knee.  
- Expand journaling: write “Today, I didn’t push. I listened. I moved with care” in bold each week.  
- Continue Monday morning ritual: whisper “Today, I honor my body. I move with care. I listen. I protect.” as a meditation before swim.  

**Key Terms & Definitions:**  
- **Presence**: Active, mindful engagement with the body — not passive, but intentional and attentive.  
- **Knee breath**: The sensation of knee relaxing, syncing with breath — a sign of deep trust and neural integration.  
- **Pre-swim checklist**: 5-min walk, 2-min glute squeeze, swim log (length, knee rating, stiffness).  
- **Post-run squeeze**: 30-second glute squeeze after every run as a reaffirmation of care.  
- **Swim volume**: Max 10% increase per week; capped at 300m by end of Month 4.  
- **Knee rating**: 1–5 scale (1 = no stiffness, 5 = sharp pain).  

**Constraints & Preferences:**  
- **No running** until Week 2, only on flat terrain, with 5-min walk-in/out.  
- **No high-impact, no hills, no sprints, no consecutive sessions**.  
- **No pushing through pain** — stop immediately if discomfort exceeds 4/10.  
- **Recovery days**: 3 full rest days per week, sacred and non-negotiable.  

**Approaches Tried & Ruled Out:**  
- **High-volume running**: Ruled out due to knee history — replaced with low-impact alternatives.  
- **Sprint or hill work**: Ruled out — increases knee stress and risk of flare-ups.  
- **Multiple run days**: Ruled out — limited to 1x/week to prevent overuse.  
- **Bike frequency**: Limited to 1x/week (max 3 total) to avoid joint fatigue.  

**Next Phase**: Transition to Week 5 with 300m swim, 10-min walk, and 1x bike session — all under the same principles of presence, care, and knee protection.
